acceptance_checks.when: The detector selftest seeds and captures them
acceptance_checks.then: Each fresh application PNG is loaded at native dimensions and byte-matches its source capture before detector assertions proceed
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Run the detector selftest against the browser fixture and compare the fresh raster with each source PNG byte-for-byte

acceptance_checks.given: A validated live raster and the normal reference writer and comparator
acceptance_checks.when: A fresh capture is compared, a DOM marker is added, then removed
acceptance_checks.then: The unchanged frame compares equal, the marked frame is rejected, and a new restored frame compares equal while immutable reference hashes remain unchanged
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Run the detector selftest and verify fresh-frame comparison, marker rejection, restoration, and unchanged reference hashes

acceptance_checks.given: Stale build stamps, environment mismatches, unknown scenarios, or invalid mutation flags
acceptance_checks.when: The detector selftest validates its inputs
acceptance_checks.then: It rejects each invalid case and retains the existing environment and reference-integrity guards
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Run invalid-input selftest cases for build, environment, scenario, and mutation validation

acceptance_checks.given: Unchanged application code and platform-bound references
acceptance_checks.then: It independently renders the live app and compares exact PNG bytes, preserving both baseline and actual PNGs on mismatch; Linux CI uploads only generated failure screenshots
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Run canonical visual comparison and inspect paired mismatch artifacts and Linux CI upload scope
